verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a hosted verification flow that is embedded in web applications, plus native SDKs and APIs. These are developer integration paths. The 'no engineering tickets' claim applies to compliance editing the onboarding flow from the dashboard, which is a different feature. Nothing in the pack documents an ops user sending a one-off verification by shareable link or QR code.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can send a verification to someone with a no-code link or QR code — no engineering ticket to verify a one-off customer, contractor, or seller
